title: Black Friday Doorbusters
parts:
🏷️ BLACK FRIDAY DOORBUSTERS

Six devy risers still marked down on most waiver wires. Every one is 19% rostered or less on Fantrax.

Ranks: the Alpha Draft Signal, thru Wk 11. Production: ESPN box scores thru Week 12, Fantrax scoring.

Shop early 👇

🏷️ Evan Medders, QB, Air Force (SO) | 15% rostered

Preseason QB #514, now #109.

21.0 FP/G his last 3. 7.1 yds per carry on 105 carries, 8 rush TD.
19% of the carries in his 9 games, in an offense that runs it 62 times a game.

We flagged him Nov 10 at 15%. Still 15%.

🏷️ Javion Kinnard, RB, San Diego State (SO) | 16% rostered

Preseason RB #181, now #88.

38% of SDSU's carries in his 10 games, 43% over his last 3.
812 rush yds at 5.8 per carry, and he led the backs (13-86) in the 22-20 win over Boise State.

🏷️ Herschel Turner, RB, Nevada (JR) | 9% rostered

Preseason RB #220, now #108.

6.5 yds per carry on 114 carries, 28% of Nevada's carries.
Week 11 vs Northern Illinois: 13 carries, 153 yds, 2 TD, 28.4 FP.
Week 12 vs Hawai'i: 15 touches, 105 yds.

🏷️ Alex Taylor, WR, Georgia Southern (JR) | 8% rostered

Preseason WR #425, now #113.

Last 3: 16 rec, 256 yds, 2 TD, 17.9 FP/G.
That's 32% of Georgia Southern's receiving yards, up from 23% on the season.

🏷️ Micah Gilbert, WR, Notre Dame (JR) | 19% rostered

Preseason WR #271, now #85.

Last 3: 17 rec, 242 yds, 3 TD, 19.7 FP/G.
28% of Notre Dame's receiving yards in that stretch, 23% on the season.

🏷️ Kyle Frendt, TE, Wyoming (SO) | 4% rostered

The cheapest tag in the store: preseason TE #190, now #36, and 4% rostered.

Last 3: 11 rec, 209 yds, 2 TD, 17.4 FP/G.
37% of Wyoming's receiving yards in that stretch. From a tight end.

The fine print: they're cheap for a reason. Turner splits the backfield, Medders plays QB in an option offense with an 'undisclosed' tag (Fantrax, 11/21), and Frendt's run is three games long.

Doorbusters still sell out. Who's in your cart? 👇
